Items: a latte-style coffee (about 150 ml of milky coffee), a Greek-style yogurt pot (~150 g), a poached egg (~50 g), 2 grilled tomato halves (~120 g), and 3-4 mushrooms (~40 g).

Energy estimates:
- Coffee with milk: ~60 kcal for ~200 g. The cup looks mostly drunk, with residue left, so ~180 g and ~55 kcal.
- Yogurt, Greek style: ~150 g at ~140 kcal (full-fat Greek style is around 120-150 kcal).
- Poached egg: ~50 g, ~75 kcal.
- Tomatoes, grilled with oil: ~120 g, ~40 kcal.
- Mushrooms: ~40 g, ~15 kcal (they may have been cooked in a little oil, so ~20).

Total energy: 55 + 140 + 75 + 40 + 20 = 330 kcal.
Total mass: 180 + 150 + 50 + 120 + 40 = 540 g.
